slides.text: Sunday night anxiety? Try this *4-minute reset*
*Minute 2:* Circle only what you can fix this week.
*Minute 4:* Do *one tiny step* now. Send one message.
Then put the phone away. *Shower. Music. Walk.*
If it feels heavy all the time, *talk to a professional.* This is general advice.

slides.sub: Follow for one mind rule a day

caption:
A short reset for the Sunday scaries: list, filter, plan, one small step.
